title: Find the Difference of Two Arrays
goal: Return distinct values present only in each of two arrays.
strategy: Membership sets remove duplicate occurrences. Check each distinct value against the opposite set; values shared by both appear in neither difference.

phasePurposes.done: Return distinct values present only in each of two arrays.

edgeCases: Identical sets yield two empty differences
Disjoint sets keep all distinct values
Signed values follow ordinary set membership
